notes: HUNT H2 pair 4 (heat 2870, x_census x pt_layers). Enemy Basri (seat 1) +1 stamps the opposing Alpine Houndmaster with a counter (+ indestructible, printed clause). Houndmaster then attacks with exactly one other creature: its own trigger 'gets +X/+0 where X is the number of other attacking creatures' — the attacking-census must count Boar (X=1) and STACK onto the counter layer: 2 base + 1 counter (CR 122.1c) + 1 census static = power 4, toughness 3 (counter only, the census is +X/+0). Combat sends 4 + 2 = 6 to seat 1 (life 14). The counter must not perturb the X census (count is creatures, not power).
